column1: # content/source/equipSlots.csv — what you can wear and when you can change it.
# Slots are data so the layout is not welded into the UI: add a row
# slot. `sets` is how many switchable loadouts that slot carries (the Right
# Hand's three sets are three weapons you cycle between
# rack). `swap` is the rule the engine enforces:
#   outOfCombat   may only be changed on the map
# `kinds` gates which armament rows (weapons.csv `kind`) fit the slot.

column8: Your set. Repaints you and steadies the numbers.
